title: NumericInput
description: Experimental (follows UI5). A locale-aware numeric textbox with range and precision validation and keyboard stepping.

usage.summary: Edit a localized number in a plain textbox with keyboard stepping.
useWhen: Enter quantities, rates or other numbers with locale-aware grouping, decimal places and bounds.
Allow direct editing with keyboard stepping and retain invalid entries for correction.

avoidWhen.when: Show increment and decrement buttons alongside the editable value.
Enter identifiers, postal codes or phone numbers, where leading zeros and exact characters matter.
